goldens.source: SoundBender Tests/Goldens at soundshop c448639, rendered by its swift-accelerate engine; LUFS rounded to 1e-4 by its manifest
goldens.format: float32 little endian, planar (all of channel 0, then channel 1), no header

ebu.source: EBU Tech 3341 (2023) table 1 and EBU Tech 3342 (2023) table 1

signals.sine_segments: Planar channels of a sine at hz, phase 0 at the first sample and running on across segments; each segment lasts round(end · rate) − round(start · rate) samples, its amplitude per channel is 10^(dbfs/20) (peak level), or silence when dbfs is null. weights are the BS.1770 channel weights.
signals.sine_ratio: amplitude · sin(2π n / rate_divisor + phase_degrees), equal in every channel, with a raised-cosine fade in and out of fade_ms.
signals.oversampled_burst: At oversampling · rate: a sine of rate/base_divisor and base_amplitude; at the zero crossing nearest the middle, one period of rate/burst_divisor and burst_amplitude, then the base sine again from phase 0; a raised-cosine fade of fade_ms. Low-passed with a Hann-windowed sinc of lowpass_taps taps cut at rate/2 with unity gain at DC, then one sample in oversampling kept, starting at offset.

ebu.tolerance: The expected value may be off by up to `below` under it and `above` over it.
